description: This Java source file defines the VoicemailFilterFactory class, which provides static factory methods to create VoicemailFilter objects for filtering voicemail data based on various criteria, including where clauses, matching fields, read status, and combining filters with AND/OR logic.

classes.name: VoicemailFilterFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to create VoicemailFilter objects for various filtering needs.

methods.name: createWithWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter with a specified where clause string.

methods.name: createWithMatchingFields
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter matching the fields set in a given Voicemail object.

methods.name: createWithReadStatus
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter for voicemail entries with the specified read status.

methods.name: createWithAndOf
methods.description: Combines multiple VoicemailFilters with an AND clause.

methods.name: createWithOrOf
methods.description: Combines multiple VoicemailFilters with an OR clause.

methods.name: getClauses
methods.description: Helper method to extract where clauses from an array of VoicemailFilters.

methods.name: getWhereClauseForMatchingFields
methods.description: Generates a combined where clause string based on the non-null fields of a Voicemail object.
